simple.meaning: פִּקָּדוֹן (piqqâdôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “a deposit.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פִּקָּדוֹן (H6487) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 41:36, with occurrences in Genesis, Leviticus.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פִּקָּדוֹן (H6487) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פִּקָּדוֹן (H6487) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פִּקָּדוֹן (piqqâdôwn) / H6487 is traced through Genesis 41:36, Leviticus 5:21, Leviticus 5:23 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
